title: Project switcher: highlight on the current project, list fade, centred Add — round 3

steps.headline: "Add a project" is now centred at the bottom of the switcher.
steps.changed: Its plus and words moved from the left edge to the middle of the row.
steps.notice: It still opens the folder picker, as before.

steps.headline: No mark on the project you're in: its row is simply highlighted when the switcher opens.
steps.changed: The check beside the name is gone. The outlined highlight starts on the project you are in.
steps.notice: The bin doesn't show on it until you point at it, so "remove" never waits on the row you were about to pick.

steps.path: Project switcher, moved to another row
steps.headline: Point at (or arrow to) another project and the highlight moves there, with its bin; leave the list and it returns.
steps.changed: The highlight follows the pointer and the arrow keys; moving the pointer off the list puts it back on the project you're in.
steps.notice: This picture moved it with the arrow keys; pointing does the same.

steps.path: Projects → click the name, with many projects
steps.headline: With many projects, the list now fades at the edge that has more, like the sessions menu.
steps.changed: Rows fade out at the bottom (and at the top once you scroll) instead of being cut off by a hard edge.
steps.notice: The fade only shows on a side that has more to scroll to.

steps.headline: The popup's top fade now fades evenly; the bright stripes at the cards' edges are gone.
steps.changed: The fade used to leave a thin strip at each side unfaded, so card edges glowed. It now fades across the whole width.
steps.notice: Most visible on light themes; on dark ones the edges were already faint. This is the shared popup fade, so every scrolling popup changes the same way.

steps.path: Projects page, a folder that doesn't sync
steps.headline: The project page's sync pill now says "Not synced", the same as the switcher.
steps.changed: Was "Only on this computer". Clicking the pill still explains it in a full sentence.
steps.notice: Nothing else on the page changed.

steps.path: Project switcher at phone width, many projects
steps.headline: At phone width the list fades the same way, and the bin shows on every row (there is no pointing on a phone).
steps.notice: The highlight still starts on the project you're in.
